text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — PR #1234 (dashboard presets) landed but the cost breakdown widget is rendering empty on some accounts. I traced it to a param rename in the dashboard schema (costMetric -> cost_key) plus one broken link to the trace hook Go example that 404s.
Alex: :eyes: Reproduced locally. The preset generator still writes `costMetric` into the JSON, runtime expects `cost_key` now. Minimal fix is a migration snippet in the docs and a tiny PR to the preset generator.
Dan: I think the rename happened in the metrics v2 refactor (last week). We shipped backward compat in runtime but not in the presets generator. Quick patch: accept either key in the generator output and add a docs note.
Sasha: I can open a patch for the generator and update the docs examples. Which files contain the generator code/examples? I found `docs/console/presets/api-presets.md` that shows the JSON sample.
Maya: Yep, that one. Also the Go trace hook example link in the tracing hooks guide is stale — it points to the old repo path. The broken link is in `docs/console/tracing/hooks.md` under the "export examples" section.
Alex: For the docs change, propose 2 PRs: one tiny code change in infra/presets (semver patch) and one docs PR with migration note + updated examples and link. We should include a short migration bash snippet to convert existing saved presets:

```
# quick migration: replace old key with new in all saved presets
for f in /var/presets/*.json; do
  jq 'if has("costMetric") then .cost_key = .costMetric | del(.costMetric) else . end' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"
done
```

Dan: Nice. Add a note about validating on staging because some accounts have custom dashboards that may rely on the old key.
Sasha: I'll update the docs page with both Node and Go SDK snippet parity. For Go I'll point to the new example in `examples/tracehook-go` and for Node to `examples/tracehook-node`. Also will fix the 404.
Maya: Can you also add a one-line changelog entry under "Console observability" and tag the PR with `docs`, `needs-qa`? QA will verify cost numbers show up again.
Sasha: Will do. Drafting PR now — will include example diffs and the migration snippet.
docs-bot: CI: presets-generator-unit-tests passed ✅ (build 8273). coverage 98%.
qa-bot: Staging run queued for 2026-03-22T15:10Z — tests include dashboard-render and cost-aggregation smoke tests.
Alex: Timeline: Sasha opens PR in next 45m, Maya will review. Dan please watch the infra deploy for the generator patch; we might want a quick canary rollout (10%).
Dan: On it. If staging looks good we can roll to canary and monitor traces/costs.
Maya: Thanks team. Post-merge checklist: 1) backfill any saved presets via migration job (ops), 2) update release notes, 3) ping customers who reported empty widgets. I'll create follow-ups. :thumbsup:
Sasha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1290 (draft) — includes link fixes + migration note + SDK snippet parity. Tagging @Maya @Alex for review.
Maya: Reviewing now. If everything looks ok I'll merge and assign ops for migration job.
Alex: Small nit: in the Node snippet we should show the new `cost_key` field name explicitly and call out the older backwards-compatibility helper.
Sasha: Good catch, will add.
Maya: Closing loop — thanks everyone. Will post a short announcement in #release-war-room once canary passes.
